title: FSM Deadlock in WAIT State — No Timeout Escape
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] FSM stuck in WAIT for 10000 cycles; ack never asserted
rtl:
always_comb begin
  next_state = state;
  case (state)
    WAIT: if (ack) next_state = IDLE;  // Stuck forever if ack never asserts
  endcase
end
testbench: task run(); drive_req(); // ack never arrives endtask
expected_root_cause: The WAIT state transition depends exclusively on the external ack signal with no watchdog timer; if the upstream ack source stalls or disconnects the FSM never exits WAIT, hanging the entire pipeline indefinitely.
description: The FSM waits for an external ack signal to leave the WAIT state; if the downstream block stalls permanently and ack never arrives the FSM hangs forever with no watchdog timeout.
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] FSM stuck in WAIT for 10000 cycles; ack never asserted
success_log: Timeout fires after 201 cycles. FSM escapes WAIT and returns to IDLE.
